title: Docs section manifest
description: navigation/sections/<id>.yaml in the Platform repo, kept by the section's team (CODEOWNERS). It sets the products-menu entries and the menu's order and version-in only; names come from the Doc space manifests. Fields are only ever added.

id.description: The section id; the file is named <id>.yaml.

products.description: The products-menu entries, in wso2.com's order.

label.description: Exactly as wso2.com names the product.

opens.description: A Doc space (where its version selector opens), one of its Editions, or one page in it. Never a section page: sections have none.

page.description: A page path inside the Doc space, for example guides/monetization/.

menu.description: The left menu, in order: Doc spaces (the family Cloud first, then products) and links out.

version-in.description: menu also gives the entry its own version dropdown. Default: menu with two or more Editions, else header.
